target.title: feat: support GPT-5.6 Ultra across OpenClaw and Codex runtimes
target.body:
Related: #98296, #103324

Builds on #98333, #103510, and #103581. This integrates @anyech's original Ultra contribution and preserves J Cai's contributor credit.

## What Problem This Solves

GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra, and Luna are first-class OpenAI models, but Ultra behavior was not coherent across OpenClaw's embedded runtime and the native Codex app-server runtime. Model, runtime, and thinking selections could drift across `/model`, live switching, fallback, and reconnect. The embedded runtime could also request maximum inference effort without representing Ultra's proactive sub-agent semantics.

Native Codex Sol/Terra use multi-agent V2, whose spawn lifecycle is emitted as `subAgentActivity` rather than the V1 `collabAgentToolCall`. OpenClaw previously ignored that V2 event: the child ran and replied, but no OpenClaw task row was created or delivered.

## Why This Change Was Made

- Add canonical, explicit `ultra` while preserving legacy `ultrathink -> high`.
- Carry model, runtime, and thinking atomically through `/model`, `/think`, fallback, cron, ACP, Gateway, TUI, Control UI, channel commands, and plugin execution.
- Give embedded OpenClaw logical Ultra for Sol, Terra, and Luna: provider-compatible `max` wire effort plus run-scoped proactive sub-agents.
- Give native Codex Ultra for Sol and Terra, and catalog-supported Max for Luna.
- Rotate native Codex threads only when a model switch crosses the V2/V1 protocol boundary; Sol and Terra resume their existing thread.
- Mirror parent-scoped Codex V2 `subAgentActivity` into the shared task lifecycle while reusing the trusted child completion/transcript delivery path.
- Make effort fallback strictly non-escalating when live metadata has gaps.
- Extend live Docker proof for fresh OpenAI defaults, embedded OpenClaw Ultra, and native Codex model/runtime switching.

## User Impact

- Fresh API-key setup selects `openai/gpt-5.6`.
- Fresh Codex/OAuth setup selects exact `openai/gpt-5.6-sol`.
- Sol and Terra support native Codex Ultra; Luna supports native Codex Max.
- Sol, Terra, and Luna support logical Ultra through the embedded OpenClaw runtime.
- Native Codex V2 children now appear as real OpenClaw tasks and deliver their completion to the parent.
- Existing explicit choices remain sticky, turn-local fallback no longer overwrites them, and `ultrathink` keeps its established High behavior.

## Evidence

- Exact final head: `dd96537cc7c60f32e8fdd51caf1a55571af6cc70`.
- Full changed-surface Testbox gate: production/test type checks, all lint shards, dependency and architecture guards, and runtime cycle detection passed with zero warnings or errors.
- Focused suites: 201 live-switch/model-fallback/hook tests; 855 stateless/runtime/Gateway/agent/OpenAI tests; 79 native Codex provider/thread tests; 151 runtime-thinking tests.
- Codex V2 bridge: 55 focused tests; SDK surface report: 9 tests and exact clean check at 10,490 public exports / 5,236 callable exports.
- Fresh autoreview: one duplicate-event finding fixed by accepting only Codex's authoritative completed activity phase; rerun clean with no actionable findings.
- Exact-head full release-gate CI: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29095741183
- Dedicated exact-head live GPT-5.6 runs:
  - Embedded OpenClaw Ultra across Sol, Terra, and Luna: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29095751354
  - Fresh OpenAI API-key default (`openai/gpt-5.6`): https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29095752712
  - Native Codex Sol Ultra, Terra Ultra, and Luna Max, including V2 task completion: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29095753951

The release-gate build initially exposed an unrelated current-main Control UI raw-copy baseline drift from #103657. This branch refreshes that single generated baseline entry; the exact i18n check and final build-artifacts lane pass.

### Codex contract checked

Current Codex source advertises Sol, Terra, and Luna separately, carries `ReasoningEffort::Ultra`, derives proactive multi-agent mode for Ultra, preserves model changes within a thread when the protocol version is compatible, maps Ultra to provider-compatible `max` only at the inference boundary, and emits V2 child identity through `subAgentActivity`.

### Known live-auth limitation

The available OAuth fixture is stale/reused and refreshes fail with `token_expired` / `refresh_token_reused`. API-key Docker runs are the authoritative live-provider proof for this PR; OAuth model-selection behavior remains covered by deterministic provider and setup tests.
